heads: original selected Stage2 PatchTST heads, frozen; same architecture and initialization
regions: six disjoint original-time bands of 16 points x seven variables; all overlapping patch copies updated
regional_interventions: replace one region's missing values with clean history under each of nine source-head combinations
move missing repaired values halfway toward clean history for each model under its own frozen head
replace one region's E23 missing repaired values with T1 estimates under the original E23 frozen head
padding_control: native replay, zero and replicate padding, full-history oracle with native or zero padding; regional comparisons fix padding to zero
metrics: global and regional hidden repair MSE/MAE
integrity: replay own-head native forecasts within 1e-6; verify source/config/checkpoint hashes and runtime states before/after
scope: development diagnosis on a seed selected from existing test results; not formal multi-seed evidence, not physical causality
